snippet.title: Etrange Overlord - Release Date Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, and PC)
snippet.description:
Etrange Overlord launches March 26, 2026! Join Étrange von Rosenburg on her musical journey through hell and heaven as she tries to have her cake and eat it, too. Falsely accused of assassinating the king, she is swiftly executed. But this ending is just the beginning, since even hell can't keep a good villainess down!

Fight your way through action-packed arenas and make use of the revolving Lanes to control the chaos in this unique action adventure. A bevy of lovable characters designed by legendary illustrator Shinichiro Otsuka are yours to control as you ride, fight, and sing your way through the afterlife.

And you don't have to go it alone. A separate multiplayer mode lets you bring your friends along to master the mayhem. Experience Etrange Overlord alone or together when it comes out for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, and PC on March 26, 2026.

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/etrange-overlord/
